title: 🎄 Kubernetes Masterclass
description: A series of hands-on, Kubernetes/Docker challenges. Take on the role of the Senior Security Elf and defend the North Pole cluster against the rogue elf faction!

items.title: The Trainee Elf Orientation
items.description: • Topics: YAML Debugging, Image Pinning, Namespace Scoping - Fix 3 simple but critical manifest errors left behind by the rogue elves. Perfect for your first day!

items.title: The Trainee Elf OJT
items.description: • Topics: kubectl describe, kubectl logs, Kubernetes Secrets - Debug ImagePullBackOff, CrashLoopBackOff, and extract hardcoded passwords into Secrets.

items.title: The Trainee Elf Graduation
items.description: • Topics: Services, ConfigMaps - Expose a deployment with a ClusterIP Service and provide application configuration via ConfigMaps.

items.title: The Poisoned Present
items.description: • Topics: Trivy, Supply Chain, CVE Remediation - The rogue elves reintroduced ancient, vulnerable dependencies into the Sleigh Telemetry image. Bump versions, swap the base image, and track down the findings that requirements.txt never mentions, until the vulnerability scan comes back clean.

items.title: The Exposed Coordinates
items.description: • Topics: Kubernetes Secrets, Helm, Volume Mounts - The Sleigh Routing API is leaking the Master Guidance Coordinates through a plaintext env var. Refactor the Helm chart to securely mount the secret as a file.

items.title: The Frozen Handshake
items.description: • Topics: Kubernetes TLS, Secrets, Helm, Volume Mounts - The telemetry client cannot reach a secure endpoint because the CA certificate is missing. Mount the cert from a Secret so TLS validation succeeds.

items.title: The Impatient Elf
items.description: • Topics: initContainers, Pod Startup Ordering, CrashLoopBackOff - The rogue elves moved the catalog-restocking elf out of the prep shift: the shop now opens before the shelves are stocked and crash-loops. Diagnose the race and put the elf back in line.

items.title: The Bloated Sleigh Image
items.description: • Topics: Dockerfile, Multi-Stage Builds, Non-Root Containers - The rogue elves shipped a 1GB+ container image running as root. Rewrite the Dockerfile to produce a secure, slim (<250MB) image using multi-stage builds.

items.title: The Skeleton Key
items.description: • Topics: RBAC, ServiceAccounts, Least Privilege - The gift-tracking workload was handed cluster-admin "temporarily" and never had it revoked. Destroy the skeleton key and grant back only what the workload actually needs.

items.title: The Trojan Manifest
items.description: • Topics: Security Context, RBAC, Probes - The rogue elves submitted a misconfigured manifest. Fix all policy violations to meet North Pole production standards.

items.title: The Phantom Storage
items.description: • Topics: Deployment, StatefulSet, Storage Classes, PVCs, Services - The rogue elves intentionally wiped the storage and network configurations from the gift-tracking application. Restore the Persistent Volumes and internal Services to reconnect the application!
